title: One nation's organisation (OA) sheets: every counter, by formation
description: data/oa/<nation>.json. A formation is one OA sheet (a division, a brigade group, or a heading such as 'Unassigned Artillery Units'). Values as printed (4.43, 4.45b, 4.45c in the chart sets).

basic_morale.description: Printed basic morale; null where the sheet says the units take another unit's morale

basic_morale_alt.description: The value printed in parentheses beside it, if any (see rules/10-units-and-state.md, morale)

attached.description: Counters whose home is another sheet but which this sheet lists as attached (not assigned) to one of its units; each counter has one id, on its home sheet

id_code.description: Key into tables/unit-characteristics.json for this nation; null where the sheet prints none (a unit listed for attachment, whose code is on its home sheet)

toe_mark.description: Printed instead of a TOE: N = the maximum TOE for its ID code; U@n / O@n = under / over strength at n points

parent.description: The unit it is assigned to on the sheet; null for the formation's top unit or an unassigned unit

arrives.description: Printed arrival (the sheet prints OpStage/Game-Turn); deployed = D, placed before play begins; null where the sheet prints none

morale.description: Only where the sheet gives this unit a morale other than the formation's
